risk: Aliases can create duplicate media rows.
proof: Two paths resolve to one physical file.
verification: A symlink duplicate fixture is rejected.

risk: An interrupted run can block every later run.
proof: The lock remains after process death.
fix: Reap locks owned by dead local processes.

risk: A failed release can leave installed owners split.
proof: The second copy fails after the first copy changes.
fix: Restore every changed target on failure.
verification: A forced failure restores matching hashes.

risk: A misspelled classification can silently change edit eligibility.
proof: Unknown values pass through the manifest builder.
fix: Reject values outside the declared enum.
verification: An unknown classification fixture exits nonzero.

risk: An empty manifest crashes before it can return a valid empty result.
proof: The reader accesses the first row without checking length.
fix: Use the declared field list when there are no rows.
verification: An empty fixture writes headers and exits zero.

risk: Per-group counters can create duplicate sequence numbers.
proof: The counter resets inside each group loop.
fix: Assign sequence numbers after all rows are combined.
verification: A multi-group fixture has one unique ordered sequence.

risk: Duplicate owner matches can be mistaken for verified delivery.
proof: The matcher accepts the first of two equal candidates.
